name: Aethris: Into the Unknown
source:
Sometimes life doesn’t make sense. One moment, you're pulling your hair at a screen. The next, you're in Aethris — where magic is the lifeblood.

Trapped, and handed a title you never asked for: The Chosen One. Your only lead home is to master magic and fulfill an unknown mission.

Your investigation leads you to two men who possess precisely what you need. However, in Aethris, access is never free.

How far will you go?

[From [url=https://lunikadev.itch.io/aethris-into-the-unknown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有时生活没有意义。某一刻，你在屏幕前揪着头发。接下来，你将来到艾瑟里斯——魔法是这里的命脉。

陷入困境，并获得了一个你从未要求过的头衔：天选之人。你唯一的归宿就是掌握魔法并完成未知的任务。

你的调查让你找到了两个人，他们正是拥有你所需要的东西。然而，在Aethris中，访问从来都不是免费的。

你会走多远？

[来自[url=https://lunikadev.itch.io/aethris-into-the-unknown]itch.io[/url]]
